text:
alex-warden: Heads-up — StellarPay just escalated. We're seeing p99 tail latency spike on Dedicated pools after last night's model rollout. Customer is threatening to fail over if we don't have a mitigation in 3 hours. TL;DR: need owner for hotfix + ETA.

meera_k: thanks — looking at traces now. early sign it's KV cache invalidation after the variant switch, p99s are ~2.1s higher on long-context requests. attaching logs in a sec. @dan_patel any routing changes rolled in last deploy? :eyes:

dan_patel: not from routing side. we did push a kernel selector tweak to runtime groups-7 at 02:14 which might affect cache keys. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rt#4321

julie.ops: cc support: we told StellarPay we'll have a plan within 2h. they want an ability to throttle to legacy model if needed. Is that a config flip or requires a rollback?

meera_k: quick mitigation: enable prefix KV warmup for sessions > 4k tokens and route long requests to the compatible model-quantized variant. It's a config change + routing policy tweak. I can ship the config in 30m if we agree.

dan_patel: config flip + routing rule is fastest. rollback of runtime kernel selector would require a rebuild and rollout, ~3-4h. recommend config first.

alex-warden: assign owners: @meera_k for the config change, @dan_patel for routing rule and verification. I'll take stakeholder comms and coordinate with account team.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-1768 (priority: P1) — assigned to eng-platform oncall. Acknowledge within 5m to avoid pager escalations.

lin_pm: appreciate the quick response. can we also add a canary traffic split to test the config against a subset of StellarPay keys before full flip? they'd like a gradual approach.

meera_k: yep — plan: 1) create canary route (5% traffic) -> 2) enable KV warmup -> 3) monitor p99 & errors for 20m -> 4) ramp to 100% if green. I will open the canary change now.

dan_patel: pinging infra to pre-warm the fallback nodes. I'll also add a short-lived routing policy:
```
route "stellarpay" {
  - model: model-quantized-v2
  - split: 95/5
  - ttl: 20m
}
```
I'll push as a FRAG in infra-config and link the change here.

julie.ops: ok I'm on comms. telling StellarPay ops: rolling canary now, expect 5% initial impact window, we'll update at +20m.

alex-warden: Meera/Dan — please add ETA updates in this thread. Also drop PR/commit links so support can reference.

meera_k: canary PR: https://git.redwood/serving/configs/merge_requests/789 — will ship in ~18m and patch in 30m if no regressions. ETA full remediation 2.5h (if canary passes).

dan_patel: infra fragment: https://git.redwood/infra/configs/commits/ae12f -> applying now. I'll validate on the canary route and post perf numbers.

oncall-bot: Pager paused for oncall handoff window. Remember to run incident postmortem template after stabilization. :memo:

meera_k: initial canary metrics (5m after deploy): p99 down 1.6s -> stable, error rate unchanged. continuing 20m window.

dan_patel: verified routing logs: canary traffic hitting model-quantized-v2, cache hit ratio improved ~12%.

julie.ops: StellarPay ops acknowledged, grateful for the rapid response. requesting written timeline for their audit log — can one of you drop the final steps and timestamps once complete?

alex-warden: noted. if canary stays green we'll ramp to 50% at +40m and 100% at +60m. final note for audit: change set ids are in the PRs above, incident id INC-2024-1768. I'll update once ramp completes.

meera_k: ramping to 50% now.

dan_patel: monitoring p99 and KV miss rate. no regressions so far.

meera_k: ramp to 100% complete. final p99 numbers back to baseline. closing the loop with Account and Ops.

alex-warden: great work. owners: meera_k (runtime/config), dan_patel (routing/infra), julie.ops (customer comms). postmortem owner: alex-warden. tagging for follow-ups: add a TODO to explore root cause in runtime selector tests. :white_check_mark:
